changes: Made the session.ts INIT/INIT_CHECK next-step guidance gitRoot-aware (added a configuredGitRootResolved flag to the next-step ctx, reusing the existing configured-gitRoot resolution) so wrapper-root projects with a resolvable gitRoot are no longer told to git init the metadata root; and added stdio pipe to the worktree.ts dev_start nesting probe so its fatal stderr no longer leaks on wrapper-root. Guidance/cwd only; bootstrap behavior, gate semantics, nesting rejection, and plain-repo behavior unchanged.
usage: On a wrapper-root project (metadataRoot not a git repo, configured gitRoot resolves), lattice next / session guidance points to INIT_CHECK instead of git init, and story_advance INIT_CHECK no longer prints fatal: not a git repository.
expectedOutcome: wrapper-root next/INIT guidance no longer says git init the metadata root; INIT_CHECK prints no fatal line; plain no-gitRoot keeps the git-init guidance.
actualTranscript: node dist/cli.js next on a wrapper-root fixture: Note: Metadata root is not a git repo; configured gitRoot supplies the signed workspace for git-backed operations (no git init). The smoke leak-control proves the pre-fix default execSync leaks the fatal while the fixed stdio-pipe form does not; a real worktree-* branch is still rejected. See evidence/transcript-diff.md; lattice validate GREEN (7/7 smoke).
outcomeDiff: Match - the wrapper-root guidance is gitRoot-aware and the fatal no longer leaks; plain repos byte-identical.
limitations: Scoped to session.ts guidance + worktree.ts nesting cwd. lattice doctor probes are B-1637 territory. The smoke is not yet in the default validate battery (backlog B-99b6 owns that wiring).
pitfalls: This closes the external report fix #3; the report core defect was already fixed in main (reporter on a stale dist, proven by reproduction). The INIT_CHECK reconcile hit the merge-conflict-marker bug (B-7365) again under concurrent main churn during this story and was recovered manually.
